summary: Nightly: Sep 24 PvP-only hotfix logged from the EU mirror; 4 transcripts drained (2 takes, 22 izen metaNotes, 2 skips); SimC fresh (+12% Unholy); Icy Veins + Archon walled.

sources.detail: All six registered pages are Cloudflare-blocked from this runner. Direct GET with the full browser header set (UA + Accept + Sec-Fetch-* + Sec-CH-UA + Upgrade-Insecure-Requests) returned HTTP 403 with a 5,487-byte Cloudflare body on every one of the six URLs, on two attempts each. No proxy or challenge workaround was attempted. This agrees exactly with the independent pre-agent published-evidence receipt, which records http 403 and a null resolved date for all six icyveins pages. Nothing was parsed, so no letter moved and neither `snapshot` (still 2026-09-22) nor the page-stated `published` dates (2026-08-29 / 08-30 / 09-01) were touched. Stored rows stay at 80 across both brackets.

Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 163,409 (raid) and 170,060 (M+) bytes. Parsed from the page's own `<div class="tierlist ...">` containers — 4 on the raid page, 6 on the M+ page — with every entry accepted by ROSTER MATCH on its `data-original-title`, never by container position; that is what rejects the M+ page's dungeon-difficulty blocks, whose 8 entries (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) were the only unmatched values on either page. Per-bracket counts printed and reconciled BEFORE the merge against the 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank roster shape: raid 40 (S 6 / A 11 / B 17 / C 6), M+ 40 (S 2 / A 13 / B 21 / C 4) = 80 rows, 0 roster rows unmatched, 0 stored specs absent upstream. Pre-merge diff moved 0 of 80 stored cells. Era-verified from the BODY, not the metadata: both pages' og/meta description still carries the stale "The War Within Season 3" boilerplate while the visible intro reads "Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" — body over title, so seasonVerified stays s2 — and Devourer is present. Each page's own "Last Updated" line was re-read live (raid "10th August 2026", M+ "13th August 2026"), matching both the committed registry and this run's pre-agent published-evidence receipt, so `published` is unchanged and only `snapshot` advances.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76-346 KB each. Parsed the documented way: unescape `\/` -> `/` across the whole document FIRST, then find the `[tier-list=rows] … [/tier-list]` block and read `[tier-label …]<TIER>[/tier-label]` with tolerant whitespace, taking specs from their `[spec-badge=<spec>-<class>]` kebab slugs (which sidesteps the two-word-class split). Anchoring on `WH.markup.printHtml(` was deliberately avoided — the raid-healer page's decoy call is the known zero-row trap. Per-page row counts printed and reconciled against the roster shape BEFORE merging: raid 27/7/6, M+ 27/7/6 = 80 rows, 0 slugs unmatched. Pre-merge diff moved 0 of 80 stored cells. Era-verified per page from the body and title: "DPS Raid Rankings for Midnight Season 2", the intro naming the Venomous Abyss in Midnight Season 2, and Devourer DH present in both DPS lists; the Season 1 mentions are retrospective prose in the per-spec writeups, not the page's own era. Each page's JSON-LD `dateModified` was re-read live — raid 2026-08-31 x3, M+ DPS 2026-08-28, M+ healer 2026-09-10, M+ tank 2026-09-01 — identical to the committed `published` values and to this run's pre-agent published-evidence receipt, so `published` is unchanged and only `snapshot` advances.

Archon is behind a Cloudflare interstitial for the 31st consecutive day. The pre-agent source-health receipt records the registered raid route at HTTP 403 `cloudflare-challenge` and the registered M+ route at HTTP 200 `human-verification`; one bounded confirming GET per route from this session returned HTTP 403 with the "Just a moment..." body (6,041 / 6,107 bytes) and no `__NEXT_DATA__` script tag, so there is nothing to parse. No challenge was solved, replayed or proxied. Per the owner decision of 2026-09-05 the last verified S2 letters REMAIN in the consensus with their original 2026-08-25 snapshot — an outage does not remove a source — so all 80 stored letters and every page's seasonVerified: s2 are untouched.

Not reachable: the same Cloudflare wall blocks every archon.gg route (see archon-tiers). `data/encounter-tiers.json` is unchanged and still stamps `season: "s1"` with asOf 2026-08-18, so it stays quarantined behind the season gate and the Fight selector stays hidden — correct until an S2 Archon encounter rebuild can actually be fetched and stamped. 619 stored tier rows retained, above the 440 floor.

Not reachable: same Cloudflare wall as archon-tiers. The 40 stored `spec.survivability` tiers are retained unchanged at 2026-08-25. Note for the record that even when the page is reachable its aggregate `survivability` tierList has published EMPTY across all three roles since 2026-08-16, and the per-boss substitute is a measured dead end (refresh-metrics SKILL.md) — so the correct behaviour here is unchanged either way.

Not reachable: same Cloudflare wall as archon-tiers, so `props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[]` could not be read. The 32 stored "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" rows are retained unchanged at 2026-08-25, above the 25 floor.
Not reachable: same Cloudflare wall as archon-tiers. The 7 stored "95th pct HPS (Mythic)" rows are retained unchanged at 2026-08-25, above the 5 floor.

Not reachable: same Cloudflare wall as archon-tiers; the `/raid/heroic/all-bosses` DPS route is the one the source-health receipt records at HTTP 403. The 33 stored "95th pct DPS (Heroic)" rows are retained unchanged at 2026-08-24, above the 25 floor.
Not reachable: same Cloudflare wall as archon-tiers. The 7 stored "95th pct HPS (Heroic)" rows are retained unchanged at 2026-08-24, above the 5 floor.

Not reachable: same Cloudflare wall as archon-tiers; the registered M+ route returns HTTP 200 carrying a human-verification page rather than the app payload, which is why a 200 here is not data. The 40 stored "M+ score (95th pct)" rows are retained unchanged at 2026-08-25, above the 25 floor.

Not reachable: same Cloudflare wall as archon-tiers. The 79 stored "Popularity" rows are retained unchanged at 2026-08-25, above the 60 floor. No shape-check was possible because nothing was fetched; nothing was merged.

Fetched successfully but upstream has not re-snapshotted, so the coverage date cannot advance and this is not a success. Both JSON API calls returned HTTP 200 with no headers, proxy or auth: `manifest.json` (353 B) reports `snapshotDate` 2026-09-15 — the same value as the last two runs, 10 days old against the source's own clock — and `rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json` (162,376 B) returned the usual 44 blocks. The rankings file was fetched and DIFFED rather than short-circuited on the manifest, because a pinned snapshotDate is not evidence the data is frozen (the 2026-08-04 incident): selecting `categoryType` in the whitelist {dps, hps, tank} PLUS `sortField === "lowerBound"` PLUS `keyRange === undefined` gave exactly 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, and all 40 `lowerBound` values are byte-identical to stored at the 1-decimal stored precision. Merged anyway per the no-change-detector policy; specs.json is unchanged by it. asOf remains the SOURCE's 2026-09-15, never the run date. 10 days is past `maxAgeDays` 8, so the heartbeat will red — that red is the honest signal that upstream has stalled.

Recorded from the deterministic pre-agent collector's `legacy["wcl-live-raid"]`, verbatim: exact population medians have no verified sanctioned aggregate endpoint, retained S1 observations unchanged. The agent holds no WCL credentials and made no WCL request of any kind. The new supported per-encounter leaderboard series is a SEPARATE requirement and explicitly cannot green this one. `rdps` being rejected is not a WoW outage — the official schema defines it as FFXIV-only. The 47 stored "Median … (Mythic" rows keep their 2026-08-10 date and values untouched, above the 30 floor.

Recorded from the deterministic pre-agent collector's `legacy["wcl-live-mplus"]`, verbatim: exact population medians have no verified sanctioned aggregate endpoint, retained S1 observations unchanged. The agent holds no WCL credentials and made no WCL request. New leaderboard receipts cannot be used to green this historical aggregate requirement. The 40 stored rows keep their 2026-08-10 date and values untouched, above the 25 floor.

Collected by the trusted pre-agent `fetch-stable-metrics.mjs` step, not by this agent: `metrics-fetch/evidence.json` records all three meta pages at HTTP 200 on the first attempt (71,302 / 42,311 / 40,911 B), a complete 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank parse (40 rows, no omitted specs) and `sourceAsOf` 2026-09-17 read from the page's own `<time datetime>` (dateBasis source-time-datetime), not from the fetch. Applied by merging `metrics-fetch/updates.json` through apply-metrics.mjs and nothing else — no second parser was written. `node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs` passes against the receipts and git HEAD. The source's own update date is 8 days old and did not move today, so the coverage date stays 2026-09-17: partial, not success. That is 3 days past `maxAgeDays` 5, which the heartbeat will report.

All 27 DPS specs requested from `chart/get/talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk/…` with up to 3 attempts each. 24 returned charts; 3 returned the 76-byte `{"status": "error"}` body on every attempt — Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker, the same three absent since the 2026-09-03 MID2 adoption and the same three SimC has no MID2 profile for, so this is upstream absence and not a parse failure. `simc_settings.ptr` compared EXPLICITLY against the string "0" (it is truthy in JS); `simc_settings.tier` read off each chart rather than assumed, and it is MID2 on all 24, so the pool stays tier-uniform and SIM_TIER_REQUIRED is satisfied. `asOf` taken per chart from its own `timestamp`: all 24 read 2026-09-23. Pre-merge diff moved 0 of 24 profiles on any target count; the merge ran and left specs.json byte-identical. Upstream has not re-simmed since 09-23, so the coverage date cannot advance — partial, 2 days old, still inside `maxAgeDays` 5. 24 rows clears the 15 floor with no row drop.

`MID2_Raid.txt` fetched HTTP 200, 1,441,334 B, and it HAD a `DPS Ranking:` block, so the HTML fallback was not needed. Era-verified off the header BUILD string, never the visible Highcharts version: `SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69933 Live (hotfix 2026-09-24/69933, git build HEAD 1e0751c16d)`. The git hash advanced from the stored run's 09-23 build, which is the honest explanation for the movement. 46 ranking lines; the `Raid` aggregate row skipped; profile names mapped by LONGEST PREFIX with hyphens allowed in the spec token, giving 24 DPS specs at their best hero variant (the 7 unmapped names are all tank profiles and are correctly not ingested; Balance Druid, Augmentation and Devastation Evoker have no MID2 profile upstream, matching bloodmallet's absent set). All 24 values moved. The largest is Unholy Death Knight 240,871 -> 269,878, +12.04% — consistent with Blizzard's 2026-09-23 Blightfall bug fix landing in this sim build — and every other move is under 3%; nothing approaches `maxValueMovePct` 0.6, so no value_move_ack is needed. asOf is the report's own hotfix date 2026-09-24.

Collected by the trusted pre-agent `fetch-stable-metrics.mjs` step. The receipt records status `partial`: `https://mythicstats.com/period/latest` resolved to `/period/1082` at HTTP 200 (215,345 B) and the section parse was structurally sound — role subtotals Ranged 30.1 / Melee 29.8 / Tank 20 / Healer 20 summing to 99.9 — but the collector HELD the source and landed 0 rows because two specs are missing from the chart (Mage|Fire and Mage|Frost) and Mage|Frost has a nonzero stored share, which would otherwise hand that share silently to the rest of the cut. Nothing was merged, so all 40 stored rows keep their existing values and their 2026-09-24 date; the page publishes no update timestamp, so the receipt records `sourceAsOf: null` / `dateBasis: observed-undated-source` rather than inventing one. `node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs` passes. This needs a reviewed look at whether the two Mage rows are a genuine upstream omission or a markup change.

All four official channels swept. (1) The trusted official-note receipts (`official-notes/evidence.json`, checkedAt 2026-09-25T15:32:41.989Z) have both configured sources `success`: live-hotfixes topic 2336376 post 1 at v47 / 115 sections and ptr-preview topic 2344395 posts 1 (v3) / 4 (v1) / 5 (v1) / 10 sections — byte-for-byte the inventory already committed, so `pendingLedger` raised 0 new, 0 changed and 0 removed sections and every prior resolution carried by hash match. Only `checkedAt` advanced in data/official-notes.json; `node src/check-official-notes.mjs --base=HEAD` passes with 0 unresolved. The US topic JSON was independently re-fetched this run and reproduced v47 / updated 2026-09-24T00:12:25.841Z exactly. (2) Wowhead news RSS HTTP 200, 185,110 B, 40 items parsed per `<item>` block; (3) the news index (`data.news.newsData`, 20 posts, totalPages 1559) agrees with it; (4) the blue tracker (`data.blueTracker.default`, 50 entries / 42 unique topics) carries one new relevant item. ONE new feed entry logged, `kind: "hotfix"`, dated 2026-09-24 (feed 41 -> 42 builds). ⚠️ It is NOT in the configured source yet: the US compilation topic 2336376 still ends at September 23, so the September 24 block was read from the EU mirror of the same Kaivax post (eu.forums topic 625785, v49, edited 2026-09-25T00:19:06.954Z) and cross-checked line for line against Wowhead news=383108. Its content is one Delves fix plus a PvP-only movement-speed pass (Hunter Wing Clip / Improved Snaring, Mage Arcane Chrono Shift PvP Talent, Paladin Consecrated Ground — every line written "in PvP combat"), so rule 3c applies: specsAffected is empty, both highlights carry the Non-class / PvP-only prefixes, nothing reaches a spec drawer and nothing votes in the PvE outlook tally. No set bonus is touched anywhere in the block, so no `spec.tierSet.asOf` advances and the gearing mirror needed no resync. The 12.1 dev-notes thread 2317811 was fetched in full (408,996 B, 17 posts, highest_post_number 19) and is still quiet at 2026-07-31 — expected for a closed cycle, not a lost thread. No 12.2 PTR announcement: `PHASES.ptr` stays null, the 12.1.5 lane stays notes-only, and the closed WCL PTR zones 52/54/56/57 were not swept (their contract rows were removed at the flip). Recorded as leads for the owner, not acted on: Blizzard's 12.1.5 Kith'ix raid testing posts and the "Midnight Season 3 Dungeon Pool Preview", both of which are cycle-opening events that require an owner configuration change.

All 79 configured YouTube channel feeds polled (every transcribable creator with a channelId across `classes[].creators` plus the 3 `generalCreators`); 0 feed errors. Against a 1,302-id seen-set built from the four structured lanes — `pending-transcripts.json` seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] plus every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url — 366 unique unseen videos fall on or after the cycle's opening build date 2026-06-18 (derived as the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, not builds[0]). The deterministic transcript step fetched all 4 queued videos (`summary.json` verdict `ok`, 4 requested / 4 fetched / 0 cached, 23 counted requests in the 30-day window, no configured limit); no transcript was fetched by this agent. All four were read in full and resolved: 2 distilled, 2 transcript-verified-skipped, 0 left waiting. Obli's kB0bop0aUpI yielded two bracket-split Unholy DK takes (raid `buff` — the Sept 23 Blightfall fix puts Unholy ~10% clear of Frost on single-target bosses; M+ `mixed` — "neck and neck", sample under 24 h), superseding his 09-23 raid and 09-17 M+ reads. izen's mYt-nBOsKus yielded 22 metaNotes across 17 specs, his post-live read of the September 22 tuning, superseding the 11 same-spec notes from his 09-19 pre-live read of the same pass. YoDaTV's dtQ0MnB9FxI (Deathbringer vs San'layn, a hero-talent comparison entirely WITHIN Blood with no cross-spec claim) and Shadarek's UZrdIj5WLIw (an Aldrachi Reaver's Mark bug explainer) carry no spec-strength read and went to `skipped[]` with their reasons. 3 new videos queued, keyword-filtered as the nightly requires because Supadata requests are metered: Obli CtKL4uOPUIk, AutomaticJak WglElpwZpZ4, YoDaTV tnwOizGhvU0. The rest of the 366 stay deliberately UNSEEN rather than being marked seen — they are a budget cut, not a durable dismissal — and they are overwhelmingly stream VODs, raid-boss POVs, PvP duel series and WoW: Forever Classic-beta content. No tier moved: creator opinion is never tier data.

The deterministic pre-agent collector reports `brackets["wcl-leaderboard-raid"].status: "invalid"` with 0 rows against a 200 minimum, and all 320 cuts individually `invalid` with the detail "Zone identity/season/encounter/difficulty/keystone metadata differs from reviewed configuration". That is a reviewed-configuration mismatch, not an outage, so it is recorded parse_error per the run contract; the pinned zone-53 raid recipe needs an owner configuration review (the encounter set has moved under it — Blizzard is running 12.1.5 Kith'ix raid testing). The agent holds no WCL credentials and made no WCL request; nothing was recomputed or edited. The 227 stored rows keep their existing values and their 2026-09-16 collection date, above the 200 floor. These are per-encounter top-100-entry medians, never population medians.

The deterministic pre-agent collector reports `brackets["wcl-leaderboard-mplus"].status: "success"` with 320 median rows from 320 cuts, 0 empty or sparse, against a 280 minimum, and `landed["wcl-leaderboard-mplus"].rows: 320`. Its merge was already applied to data/specs.json and data/wcl-coverage.json before this agent started; the agent re-fetched, recomputed and edited nothing, and `node src/check-wcl-metrics.mjs` confirms the merged rows match the trusted collection with historical and failed/sparse cuts retained exactly. Bracket 9 = key level exactly +10 was validated by the collector against the returned metadata. These are per-encounter first-page medians of up to 100 ranked entries (minimum 10) — not population medians, not unique-player medians, and never pooled across encounters. Collection date 2026-09-25.
